steps.name: Ceylon
steps.text: I never knew there was a cave like this on the other side of the volcano.

steps.name: Provence
steps.text: This used to be a natural cave, but after extensive mining, it's turned into a deep shaft.

steps.name: Provence
steps.text: Be prepared, everyone. We still have a long way to go once we're inside.

steps.name: Provence
steps.text: Our actual destination is in the depths of this cave.

steps.name: Skyfire
steps.text: Even when I was back in the Lab, I never imagined that I'd be diving deep into a volcano during my vacation.

steps.name: Ceylon
steps.text: Can you explain what's going on to me now? That phone call was way too obscure. What did she mean by 'there's a good chance to stop the eruption?'

steps.name: Provence
steps.text: Hmm... I think Skyfire can explain it better. Help me out here.

steps.name: Skyfire
steps.text: Provence and I came to this conclusion after exploring the volcano, and we discussed it with Eyjafjalla.

steps.name: Skyfire
steps.text: To explain the theory, we'd first have to talk about the habitat of the Originium slugs... Or rather, we should call them volcanic slugs or lava slugs.

steps.name: Skyfire
steps.text: Even though they look just like normal Originium slugs, these creatures feed upon the special obsidian found in this volcano.

steps.name: Skyfire
steps.text: These Originium slugs make their colony very close to the core of the volcano, where lava mixes with special components to form large quantities of this obsidian.

steps.name: Skyfire
steps.text: Once the people here discovered that this obsidian was special, they followed the slugs' tracks to locate the source.

steps.name: Ceylon
steps.text: I see. I've read about this before. People in some places take advantage of the animals' habits to locate and exploit resources.

steps.name: Provence
steps.text: People can always draw connections from interacting with other creatures.

steps.name: Skyfire
steps.text: The problem is, there hasn't been an eruption in a long time, and the supply of obsidian started to dwindle.

steps.name: Skyfire
steps.text: Overmining doesn't just affect the industries involved, but also destroys the Originium slugs' natural habitat.

steps.name: Skyfire
steps.text: As a result, they became increasingly restless and started to burrow more and more in search of new habitats. This is most likely the source of the abnormal internal activity within the volcano.

steps.name: Skyfire
steps.text: Doing this may be effective for keeping the colony alive, but the end result is a Catastrophe for Siesta.

steps.name: Provence
steps.text: ...'If we do not protect the gifts from Nature, then Nature will instead grant us punishment.'

steps.name: Ceylon
steps.text: So, what should we do now?

steps.name: Ceylon
steps.text: Is there some method to block the volcano?

steps.name: Skyfire
steps.text: We should approach it from a different perspective. We actually need to pacify the host of this abode.

steps.name: Skyfire
steps.text: Let's hurry it up. We need to go deeper.

steps.name: Ceylon
steps.text: It's getting hotter and hotter...

steps.name: Provence
steps.text: It's just in front of us...

steps.name: Provence
steps.text: Everyone, be careful!

steps.name: Ceylon
steps.text: That roar... It sounds... as if it's crazed.

steps.name: Skyfire
steps.text: Of course. These slugs are not intelligent enough to individually explore this volcano so extensively, so there must be a queen in the colony.

steps.name: Skyfire
steps.text: She is the host that we're searching for.

steps.name: Provence
steps.text: ...We're supposed to find that queen out of all of these slugs?

steps.name: Skyfire
steps.text: What are you talking about? This volcanic Originium slug is powerful enough to trigger an eruption. She is the true host of this volcano! We should definitely be able to discern her from a glance!

steps.name: Skyfire
steps.text: The possibilities are endless for organisms that evolved under extreme environmental conditions. You never know, this slug might be powerful enough to melt an entire Defender squad.

steps.name: Ceylon
steps.text: Are you saying that these tremors were caused by a single Originium slug...?

steps.name: Skyfire
steps.text: There's nothing to be afraid of, as long as I'm here. It doesn't matter how much these slugs may have mutated--

steps.name: Ceylon
steps.text: Wh-what's that?!

steps.name: Provence
steps.text: How can this be... The lava is already coming out?!

steps.name: Ceylon
steps.text: No, that's the mutant Originium slug! Head down the cave!

steps.name: Giant Originium Slug
steps.text: Grooooooarrr!!

steps.name: Giant Originium Slug
steps.text: Grooooooarrr!!

steps.name: Skyfire
steps.text: The temperature is rising... No Originium slug should be able to maintain such a high temperature...

steps.name: Provence
steps.text: ...You're still calling it a slug? That's more like a moving volcano, don't you think?

steps.name: Skyfire
steps.text: Well... I didn't get to draw any detailed inferences, but this is definitely beyond what I had calculated for.

steps.name: Provence
steps.text: I'm starting to miss Eyjafjalla a little.

steps.name: Ceylon
steps.text: Watch out! It's getting closer to us!

steps.name: Giant Originium Slug
steps.text: Grooooooarrr!!

steps.name: Giant Originium Slug
steps.text: Groaaaaaaaar...!!!

steps.name: Ceylon
steps.text: It... It can even melt through the ground? N-No, look at the wall and the ground. They're covered with these wave-like things...

steps.name: Provence
steps.text: Move back. They're all lava Originium slugs, enough to cause volcanic activity!

steps.name: Skyfire
steps.text: I suppose this confirms our target then.

steps.name: Skyfire
steps.text: As long as we can pacify it and redirect its route, the citizens should have enough time to evacuate!

steps.name: Provence
steps.text: Hold on, hold on! How are we supposed to 'pacify' this mini-volcano?!

steps.name: Skyfire
steps.text: By beating it down! What else can we do?

steps.name: Provence
steps.text: It's got such a massive body though! What if it explodes here? Are you sure that won't cause an eruption?!

steps.name: Skyfire
steps.text: Let's just ask it to go home really nicely then!

steps.name: Skyfire
steps.text: Hmm...

steps.name: Skyfire
steps.text: I suppose we have to take it down one way or another!!
